title: Follow up qa-v1-theory-088c9d2828af992aebbd07a8
behavioral_concerns: follow up: qa_errors.go mapQAUseCaseError preserves retryable only for QAErrorConflict and QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, diverging from operations.go failedOperation QA mapping which also marks RuntimeUnavailable/PersistenceFailure as retryable runtime vs validation branching (qa_errors.go:52-53 vs operations.go:801-815)

evidence.summary: qa_errors.go:53 Retryable only for QAErrorConflict and QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable
qa_errors.go:62-63 qaPublicErrorMessage groups persistence_failure with runtime_unavailable as temporarily unavailable
operations.go:806-807 maps persistence_failure and runtime_unavailable to category runtime; 814 Retryable only for runtime_unavailable||conflict leaving persistence_failure as non-retryable runtime
handlers.go:1063-1065 maps qa.persistence_failure and qa.runtime_unavailable to 503 ServiceUnavailable; 1082-1085 forwards QAUseCaseError.Retryable to error body
sprint_commands.go:742 maps both persistence_failure and runtime_unavailable to ExitRuntime but 1565 retryable same as qa_errors excludes persistence_failure
qa_types.go:914-917 recovery guidance for persistence_failure and runtime_unavailable both imply restore-then-retry transient

theories.claim: mapQAUseCaseError excludes QAErrorPersistenceFailure from Retryable while grouping it with QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable as temporarily unavailable and HTTP 503 / runtime category, producing inconsistent retryable signal across QA adapter layers
theories.basis: qa_errors.go:53 Retryable == Conflict || RuntimeUnavailable; qaPublicErrorMessage:62-63 persistence_failure and runtime_unavailable share 'temporarily unavailable' message; operations.go:806-807 persistence_failure => category runtime but 814 Retryable == RuntimeUnavailable || Conflict (non-retryable runtime); handlers.go:1063-1065 both map to 503 ServiceUnavailable and writeQAError:1085 forwards Retryable from QAUseCaseError; sprint_commands.go:742 both map to ExitRuntime while 1565 mirrors qa_errors retryable exclusion; qa_types.go:914-917 both recoveries imply restore-then-retry
theories.verification_surface: read-only static inspection of internal/app/qa_errors.go, internal/app/operations.go, internal/app/sprint_commands.go, internal/web/handlers.go, internal/sprint/qa_types.go without execution
theories.confirmation_condition: PersistenceFailure is categorized/message/statused as transient runtime (runtime category, temporarily unavailable message, 503, ExitRuntime) but Retryable is false in QAUseCaseError and/or OperationError
theories.refutation_condition: product-intended persistence_failure is non-retryable and 503 with retryable false plus runtime category with retryable false is documented as correct
theories.inconclusive_condition: intended retryable semantics for persistence vs runtime unavailable cannot be inferred from code alone and requires product decision
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: read listed paths, record line numbers for Retryable assignments, category switch, message switch, HTTP status switch, and CLI exit mapping; compare; no shell, no mutation

theories.outcome_reason: inspection at qa_errors.go:53 and operations.go:814 confirms exclusion of persistence_failure from Retryable while message equivalence (62-63), category runtime (806), 503 mapping (handlers.go:1063), and ExitRuntime mapping (sprint_commands.go:742) all imply transient retryable runtime.
